summary: Verified new features: (1) real Nota upload via POST /api/upload with object-storage-backed /api/files/{path} auth-protected retrieval, (2) auto PPh21 progressive with bracket breakdown panel, (3) PPh 4(2) Konstruksi tiered dropdown with per-tier rate override. Both backend regression (pytest) and end-to-end UI (Playwright) passed all acceptance checks.

issues: 'Nilai Total' shows Rp 0 for PP with DPP-only entry because backend never derives doc.total from dpp; header summary is misleading. Detail tax panel & journal remain correct (they use dpp). Consider setting total = dpp on PP save.
React hydration warning: <span> child of <option> inside DocumentForm selects (dev warning only, no functional impact).

action_items: (Optional) Persist doc.total = dpp for PP so 'Nilai Total' in header/list is not Rp 0.
(Optional) Fix hydration warning: <span> rendered inside <option> from x-source annotation wrapper on option children.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/upload: file size limit good (10MB); MIME derived from ext fallback is fine. Consider whitelisting content_type to prevent uploading executables labelled as images.
server.py /api/files/{path}: correctly requires authenticated user via cookies; media_type served from DB record (safer than trusting storage response).
compute_pph mirrors JS computePph exactly (progressive+tiered+flat) — consistent client/server math.
DocumentForm.jsx onPphChange auto-fills first tier + rate; onTierChange sets override — clean UX.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 PP doc 'TEST_UI_PPH42_KONSTRUKSI' with uploaded PNG attachment (pending_approval), and 1 backend-only PP 'TEST_PPH42_KONSTRUKSI_TIER' fully approved & journalized. Journal 100jt DPP → 96jt payable + 4jt PPh (2-10005) balanced.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PPH21 progressive: 100jt DPP → 9jt PPh (60jt*5% + 40jt*15%), net with PPN 102jt. PPH42_KONSTRUKSI tier options: labels stored WITHOUT '(x%)' suffix (rate rendered by UI only). detail-tax-panel format: '{name} · {tier} ({rate}%) = {rupiah}'. Upload endpoint requires httpOnly cookie; works because backend uses same origin. Image load may take ~1-2s on first paint — wait_for_timeout(2000+) before asserting naturalWidth.
rca of the issue: N/A - all features working as specified.
